d: In an exclusive interview with The Indian Express, Uttar Pradesh Chief Electoral Officer Navdeep Rinwa says that around '2.5 crore eligible voters' are yet to be enrolled in the state’s electoral rolls. Responding to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath’s claim that 1.27 crore Hindu voters are missing and Muslim voters have increased, Rinwa stated that the Election Commission cannot provide a religion-wise breakdown, and how the ongoing Special Summary Revision (SSR) will give eligible voters an opportunity to enrol ahead of the 2027 UP Assembly elections.
